I cannot run a Monte Carlo transport code, so this is not a true simulated sample. The 200 events below follow the expected physics, but the event mix and angular sampling are approximate hand-constructed estimates, not an unbiased draw.

**Assumed composition:**
- Almost all interactions are Compton. Rayleigh, pair production and photoelectric events are each well under 1% in water at these energies, so none are included.
- About 55% of interactions are by unscattered primaries at the two line energies (equal split). The remaining 45% are by scattered photons with lower energies (0.9, 0.7, 0.5 and 0.3 MeV).
- Scattering angles are spread across four representative cosines. Electron kinetic energies and directions follow Compton kinematics.

Rayleigh, pair and photoelectric events are negligible and omitted. Scattering cosines are a fixed set of four representative values, not randomly sampled.
